headline: Google patches eighth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026
summary: Google issued emergency updates to patch a new Chrome memory vulnerability that attackers had already exploited in zero-day attacks, the eighth such actively exploited Chrome flaw patched this year.

claims.statement: Google patched its eighth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of the year.

sources.quote: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year
Google has released emergency security updates to patch a new Chrome vulnerability exploited in zero-day attacks, the eighth such flaw since the start of the year.
Chrome zero-day whack-a-mole continues as 2026 tally hits 8
